fact: From 1 October 2023 Bundung Maternal and Child Health Hospital, an urban secondary-level public facility, replaced its HMIS registers for antenatal, delivery, postnatal and immunisation services with Smart Paper Technology forms scanned at the facility, whose indicators feed the monthly DHIS2 datasets automatically, and later extended this to all its primary health care, replacing over 30 registers; a second pilot site, Faji Kunda Major Health Centre, followed in July 2024, and national roll-out awaits an evaluation.
title: Toward an Electronic Pregnancy Registry in The Gambia: Linking up Maternal and Newborn Health Data Using the Smart Paper Technology
